about: Older hairstyles (assets/avatars/hair/) that scripts/fit_hair.py anchors to every adult head: each is placed on the base head
where the game draws it, changed as listed here, then warped onto each adult head like the newer styles. Run npm run fit-hair after editing.
Per style, all optional (frame units on the 512 head canvas, y down): dx, dy move it (dy > 0 is lower); scale, scale_y resize it;
front_cut: y draws the style in front of the face only above y (below it, only behind the head, so side locks sit behind the face).
skull_fill: n draws a cap of hair behind the head, its outline grown by n, from the crown to the ears, filling gaps beside the skull.
skull_band: n (with skull_fill) also draws a band of hair n wide just inside the skull edge, in front under the style, covering the temples.
recolor: {"#from": "#to"} replaces colors in the drawing (line work that does not match the other styles).

shorten: [{below: y, k: f, beyond: d, within: e, only: left|right}] draws points lower than y, between d and e from the center line, up toward y (k 0.5 halves them). On the base head: brows y 256, eyes 293, ears attach 278, temples 116 from the center line.
